name: obscura
description: Rust headless browser as MCP tools. Fetch, scrape, extract markdown — zero config, auto-installs.

interface.shortDescription: Headless browser for AI agents — fetch, scrape, and extract web data.
interface.longDescription: Obscura is a Rust-based headless browser CLI that exposes web fetching, parallel scraping, markdown extraction, and CDP automation as MCP tools. Use it for read-only web data collection pipelines.
defaultPrompt: Use Obscura to fetch and summarize this web page.
Use Obscura to scrape product data from these URLs.
Use Obscura to extract all links from this site.
